lines.text: Super Iterator? I think I saw it. That package should be in that ⟦key|stack behind me⟧.
All the packages that got held up came in today. We got no one to spare because everyone's busy sorting the deliveries ... so I guess you'll have to find it yourself. Real sorry about this.

scenes.summary: You find the package but the crew mates become slightly nervous when they realize that the recipient is Yvonne. The crew tells you to treat the package carefully as it may contain Static Blight samples.

lines.text: Found it? Already?
Yvonne...? Is that package hers?
Well ... be extra, extra careful when moving it around. Don't bump it against anything.
I gotta work on something else! And I suggest you check the package for labels or descriptions of "Static Blight Samples"...!

options: Yvonne's package has plenty of character, just like her.
Super Iterator... She calls herself this?

r: Yvonne's package has plenty of character, just like her.
Super Iterator... She calls herself this?

scenes.summary: You deliver the package to Yvonne and realize that it only contains simple paints. Yvonne says they are not needed anymore, but she has a plan and is inviting you aboard.

lines.text: Endmin? I am totally surprised to see you here!
Tsk. Andre is being a big lazy owl again!
He made a losing bet and promised to pick up all my deliveries for this year... I can't believe he's bossing you around, Endmin! I'll make sure he gets a friendly reminder of his place.
Ugh... Picking up packages is such a hassle... Anyways, thanks a mill!
Oh, well...
Previous troubles held up delivery... And now I got no use for it anymore.
Yeah ... even though the package arrived late, you came at just the right time, Endmin! My plan is —
Hehe. Just follow me!
Newp. Not research samples. Just some ordinary paint.

options: Andre asked me to pick up a package for you.
You got a delivery. Open it.
Is it a package of research samples?
No use for it anymore?
What were you planning to use it for?

scenes.summary: Yvonne's plan is to use the paint for her Originium Science Park graffiti. Fabian Collins catches you in the act. Yvonne hollers at you to run away with her.

lines.text: Don't just stand there, Endmin! Grab a brush!
Yeah, so? Endmin, don't tell me you're scared of the Collinses.
The Science Park is really banged up so they'll start rebuilding it eventually. I say we leave our signature on the ruins to commemorate this entire mess.
Phewie...! I haven't felt this great for QUITE — A — WHILE!
Actually, I always thought the legendary Endministrator of Endfield Industries would be a super stuck-up serious person!
HEY! YVONNE —! YOU AGAIN!
Uh-oh. We gotta run!
You got nothing to fear! I'll cover you!
...or someone like Director Qin, always rushing around with a stern face, stamping piles of reports with the Endfield seal.
Heheh. Our pattern souls are vibrating! Endmin, your aesthetic is so my vibe!
Drawing is essentially the same as solving technical problems. You simply choose the most satisfying solution out of countless possibilities...
*Sigh* Since I have no use for the paint, we might as well add a splash of beautiful color on this boring wall!
When I was a kid, I read about you in those educational science books... They either described you as an old academic like Professor Crowe...
I would occasionally draw a few things while looking for inspiration.

options: Graffiti?
Is this a prank?
I guess I'll leave my mark.
Agreed. The bad art is hurting my eyes.
So, what do I look like right now?
You've been quite surprising to me as well.

scenes.summary: After hiding from Fabian Collins, Yvonne looks at her graffiti and says her work fails to deliver the "scream" she needs to get off her chest. She invites you to the Hub Base for inspiration.

lines.text: That was real close. Almost caught us red-handed.
Thank goodness it wasn't his sister, or we'd both be toast.
*Sigh* So, what do you think about our graffiti...? Think we're missing a theme?
I've seen plenty of awesome graffiti. Like at the Obsidian Festival... Every piece is a "scream" from the artist who drew it.
So... What do you want to express with your graffiti, Endmin?
The vibes you're feeling? A story you wanna tell? Or is it something else?
No matter what your answer is, the "scream" must be an eruption! An explosion right from the deepest recess of the creator's heart!
Me?
Hmm. The Hub Base... Well, I can also visit Andre along the way!
I heard an Ankhor fell right on his lab. Old boy got really lucky with that one... And yeah, since I haven't seen him for quite a while, I suppose I can swing by, you know. Give him my best wishes.
Endmin, Endfield Operator Yvonne is requesting the reservation of your time today! I must complete this graffiti while my muse is still knocking! I refuse to take no for an answer.
Heheh. I knew you'd be interested, Endmin.
Thinking of backing out? TOO LATE! You're at least fifty percent responsible for this wall graffiti.
We're in the same boat now, Endmin — like Originium Slugs on the same leash. There's no getting away.
You gotta stay with me and complete this graffiti. And you better not think about escaping!
Nevertheless, inspiration remains the heart of any creation. And since you've been all over the place after waking up, you must've found some truly inspiring spots! Come on, share a few with me!
It's something from their heart, something they truly wanna express! A raging voice that wants out, that wants to be plastered all over the viewers' faces!
Hmm...
I don't know yet! Brainstorming things on your own often lands you straight in a bottleneck...
Well, I gotta respond quickly, right?
Ahem. I did, in a way. Even found you a hiding spot, right?
You wanna start with the memories most deeply etched within your mind? That sounds great.
An old friend of the Endmin...?! You've made me quite curious.
Wow! I LURRRV that answer! That's why you're the Endmin!
I really envy you, Endmin. You seem to have it all figured out.

options: Someone told me she was not afraid of getting caught.
I thought someone was supposed to cover me.
How about a fragment of my memories?
An old friend, perhaps...
Visual impact is the only thing that counts.
The Hub Base has plenty of good ones, actually.
The place where I first saw an Ankhor.
Great. Let's get inspiration from Andre's lab.
I'm actually busy with something else...
What about you, Yvonne? Got anything to "scream" about?
